name: blog-system-v1
description: Modern personal blog system on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: bash scripts/guard-deploy.sh && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && bash scripts/migrate.sh DB --remote wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:manual: npm run build --workspace=frontend && wrangler deploy --config backend/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run check-theme --workspace=frontend && npm run test --workspace=backend

JWT_SECRET.description: 必填：用 `openssl rand -hex 32` 生成随机密钥，不要提交到 Git。
